headline: MolDesignBench reports persistent constraint and feasibility failures in molecular-design agents
summary: A September 2026 preprint introduces MolDesignBench, a benchmark of 2,000 small-molecule generation and optimization tasks. Tasks combine implicit narrative requirements with explicit chemical constraints, include infeasible specifications, and expose 17 chemistry tools. Across six general and chemistry-focused agent configurations, the authors report best success rates of 38% for generation and 43% for optimization. The benchmark tests constraint handling and tool use; it does not test experimental property measurements or whether generated molecules lead to discoveries.
